title: Zesty Chewy Saudi Arabian Spring Onions Tagine
description: A tangy and chewy one-pot dish featuring spring onions, this Saudi Arabian tagine is a macrobiotic-friendly delight, incorporating mushimono-steam for added flavor and texture.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chopped spring onions and cook until they start to soften, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lemon juice and water, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the tagine, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the spring onions are tender and chewy.
Use a steamer basket to steam the mixture over boiling water for an additional 10 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional chopped spring onions if desired.
